transcript.answer: No. In Otto, HAL Engine only fails over through `fallbackProviders`. Its `resilience` setting is a retry policy and has no fallback field. Issue #474 and PR #475 found that `buildEngine` in `apps/api/src/server.ts` passed only a `provider`, so a configured `FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` was validated against the allowlist and printed in the `api.model` startup line but was never tried. The fix passes the resolved fallback as the only entry of `fallbackProviders`, and an empty list when `FALLBACK_MODEL_ID` is unset. Otto also refuses fallbacks it cannot build. Until a fallback vendor is chosen (KU-07), only the mock row can be a fallback.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly says resilience is only a retry policy and that buildEngine never passed fallbackProviders, but it claims the mock row can be a fallback, which the gold answer says is refused.
